extDescription.message: Lightweight download interceptor. Automatically redirects browser downloads to local aria2 RPC, with right-click send and HuggingFace batch download.
extDescription.description: Extension description shown in Chrome extensions page

extDefaultTitle.message:
Aria2 Bridge
Click to open AriaNg

menuSend.description: Context menu item: send link to aria2

menuOpenAriaNg.description: Context menu item: open AriaNg management panel

menuHfDownload.message: 📥 Download all model files to Aria2
menuHfDownload.description: Context menu item: batch download from HuggingFace model page

toastSent.description: Toast shown when download is sent to aria2

toastFallback.description: Toast shown when aria2 is unavailable and download falls back to browser

notifHfModelIdFail.message: Cannot identify model ID. Please make sure the page is fully loaded.
notifHfModelIdFail.description: Notification when HF model ID extraction fails

notifHfNoFiles.description: Notification when no downloadable files are found on HF

notifHfError.message: Failed to fetch HF file list. Please refresh and try again.
notifHfError.description: Notification when HF API call fails

notifSentFallback.description: Notification body: fell back to browser

notifHfSuccess.description: Notification after successful HF batch download

notifHfPartial.description: Notification when some HF files failed

optionsRpcUrlHint.message: aria2 JSON-RPC endpoint URL. Default http://localhost:6800/jsonrpc
optionsRpcUrlHint.description: Hint text below RPC URL input

optionsSecretHint.message: The password set via aria2 startup arg --rpc-secret=xxx. Enter the password only (the extension auto-prepends token:). Leave empty for no auth.
optionsSecretHint.description: Hint text below RPC secret input

optionsDefaultDirLabel.description: Label for default download directory input

optionsDefaultDirHint.message: Leave empty to use the directory configured in aria2.conf
optionsDefaultDirHint.description: Hint text below default directory input

optionsBypassHint.message: One domain per line. Downloads from these domains will bypass the interceptor and use the browser's native download.

optionsAriaNgDesc.message: AriaNg is a web-based aria2 management dashboard. It lets you view progress, manage tasks, and adjust settings. Built into this extension.
optionsAriaNgDesc.description: Description of AriaNg in options page

optionsExtsHint.message: One extension per line (with dot). Content Script will intercept link clicks matching these extensions. Leave empty to use default list.
optionsExtsHint.description: Hint text below file extensions input

optionsLocaleHint.message: Select the display language for the extension. Refresh the settings page to apply.
